steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: Ah—!!

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: Tranquilizer. Quick!

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: M value, 1632, 1637... Please stop soon!
Back in the ward at the start, a commotion is happening. Layers of blockades are imposed. The young girl is bound to the hospital bed, struggling in pain.

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: Ahhhhhhh—!

This is the first time you hear her voice, yet it's constant, hysterical groans. The young girl was being torn by something, tearing up the wounds on her body once again. Blood soaks the hospital bed. The whole scene is appalling.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: Take my hand. Breathe and listen to me. Stay awake. Don't let it take you away. Don't give up.

steps.speaker: Gray-haired Girl
steps.content: Ha... ha... ha... Aaahhh—!!

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: It was just a nightmare! It's not real! Wake up! I'm here holding your hand right now, waiting for you to come back!

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Don't look away, the Chief of Minos. You must understand Mania, the end of Sinners.
She makes some adjustments to the equipment and watches the data changes.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Mania</color> isn't power and mutation. It's an <color=#fb9259>irreversible mental breakdown</color>.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Normal humans can't endure an M value above 200. 98.4% of the infected have a mental breakdown and turn into monsters with "power"—Corruptors.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: But the M values of Sinners are at least 600 when they are found. The reason remains unknown.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: They have endured extreme mutations while retaining their sanity and human form and even gaining stronger power as a result.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: But that doesn't mean they don't suffer.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Triggers can worsen their Mania, which not only brings stronger power but also deeper fear, sorrow, despair, stubbornness, and madness.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Until they can no longer endure it and break down like any Maniacs.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: The <color=#fb9259>mental contamination</color> which burst when they get to the threshold is the main cause for the escalation of the plague.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: The closer they get to the threshold, the more they spread fear and madness, which escalates the disaster.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: It has nothing to do with the person's willpower or whether the person is a Sinner.
The young girl starts wailing again, while her wounds start to emit faint black smoke.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: This is a sigh of a breakdown. She has reached her limit.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Aren't you going to save her?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: I can't. Mania can't be reversed. Besides—someone is monitoring her.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: I've examined her. Something nasty has been implanted into her body.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: You're quite cruel. But what if I said she's been used?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Something nasty has been implanted into her body.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: A <color=#fb9259>remote-controlled capsule</color> with a safety trigger was attached to the outer wall of her heart, which contains liquid Mania crystal.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: The capsule dissolves when a signal is received or someone tries to disable the device. In her current condition, this dose is enough to transform her into a Corrupt instantly.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content:
She has many old wounds, which suggests she has been abused...
and domesticated into a <color=#fb9259>weapon</color>.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: When she almost died, she had no choice but to crawl to the door of SALVA to seek help. Her master doesn't care if she dies.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Her master doesn't care if she dies.

steps.speaker: Choice
steps.content: How much longer can she last?
options: How much longer can she last?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: I don't know. Based on past cases, this state can last up to six hours, but she has lasted at least three days.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: This has happened many times since she arrives at SALVA, but she has made it through each time.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: She doesn't want to turn into a monster.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: And how did you guys become Sinners?
Why are you telling me this?

steps.content: You instantly regret it as soon as the words come out of your mouth. The answer is right in front of you.
Both of them have been rescuing Maniatics, working in the place closest to danger.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: ...Yeah, Anne has once asked me this too.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: How did we make it through that line, but our patients can't?
You attacked SALVA and even killed her colleagues. There's no reason for her to be honest with you.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: ...The way you looked at Brand was different than the rest of them. You weren't seeing him as an enemy or a monster.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: I know you have thought about saving him, just like I did.
These words are slightly awkward, but as Iron said, the shackles can suppress Mania in Sinners and avoid the disaster. Perhaps this could be a solution...

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Hehe, don't underestimate SALVA. This Mania isn't a pressure for me and Anne at all.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: We chose our own path a long time ago, and the path certainly doesn't lead to your bureau.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: If you interfere, I'll make you live on a top-notch pair of mechanical arms for the rest of your life.
She shows her mechanical arms with a faint smile. The cold gleam gives you chills.
Beep—The equipment rings. Iron quickly extends her mechanical arm and walks towards the young girl.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Gotta get to work now. If she wakes up this time, ask her the rest of your questions yourself.
She has already calmed down, perhaps she's just enduring the pain or simply too weak to move. Her face was pale, and her hollow eyes stare at the ceiling.
You can ask your questions now. She can no longer pose any threat to you now.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Why did you want to kill me?

steps.content: It isn't a silence from refusal to answer, but the dead silence and emptiness of someone who has lost everything. This is a soulless look that no Sinner has ever had.
They are dangerous, stubborn, narrow-minded, intimidating, and unpredictable, but never so lifeless.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Are you willing to be used as a tool?

steps.content: Since she doesn't have her own will and is willing to be a tool, she might as well be in your control. At least there will be one less person to do evil.
She was threatened by Mania. If you use shackles on her, can you free her? Can you save this Sinner?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Touch her and use the shackles

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Don't, Chief. Her Mania is already out of control. Even you won't be able to take it.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: She's beyond saving.
Please don't say that.
Anne lifts the curtain and enters. Despite the dark circles under her eyes, the smile on her face is as gentle as always.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: How can we say such discouraging words when the patient hasn't given up yet?

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: In SALVA, both the doctors and patients in this hospital believe Mania will be cured one day.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: This kid is no exception... A person who has lost their hope simply can't endure torture like this, yet she perseveres until now.
Anne holds the girl's lean, frail hand.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: You must have a place you want to go back to, right? Is there someone you cherish there? You must want to see them very much...

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: Well done. You'll get better. I'll always be here for you.
Her words are soft and determined, but her shoulders are shaking so slightly.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: This time... I'll save you.
The gray-haired girl remains silent, but her gaze is no longer fixated on the ceiling but on Anne.
The frail hand trembles and holds Anne's hand back.
—Boom!!

steps.speaker: SALVA Doctor
steps.content: The hospital is under attack! Those gangsters have returned!!!
